slide1.headline: AI Chip Startup Etched Raises $800 Million
slide1.subtitle: Gearing up for customer shipments

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 01 Jul 2026
Etched, an AI chip startup, has raised $800 million in funding.
This funding will help the company gear up for customer shipments.
The funding amount is significant, indicating the growing interest in AI chip technology.
Etched plans to use this funding to expand its operations and improve its products.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The funding of Etched is a significant development in the AI chip industry.
It highlights the growing demand for AI-powered chips.
This funding will help Etched to compete with other players in the market.
Source: Indiatimes, 01 Jul 2026

slide1.headline: SpaceX Set to Join Nasdaq 100
slide1.subtitle: Paving way for wave of passive buying

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 27 Jun 2026
SpaceX is set to join the Nasdaq 100 index.
This move is expected to pave the way for a wave of passive buying.
The Nasdaq 100 index includes the 100 largest non-financial stocks listed on the Nasdaq stock exchange.
SpaceX's inclusion in the index will make it more attractive to investors.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: SpaceX's inclusion in the Nasdaq 100 index is a significant development for the company.
It will provide more visibility and attract more investors.
This move will also increase the demand for SpaceX's stock.
Source: Reuters, 27 Jun 2026

slide1.headline: Anthropic Launches Claude Sonnet 5
slide1.subtitle: Improved coding, reasoning, and lower API pricing

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 01 Jul 2026
Anthropic has launched Claude Sonnet 5, a new AI model.
The model has improved coding, reasoning, and lower API pricing.
Claude Sonnet 5 is designed to provide better performance and efficiency.
The model has been trained on a large dataset and can handle complex tasks.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The launch of Claude Sonnet 5 is a significant development in the AI industry.
The model's improved coding and reasoning capabilities make it more useful for developers.
The lower API pricing will make it more accessible to a wider range of users.
This launch will increase the adoption of AI technology in various industries.
